is_anopheles.evidence: The study tests Anopheles gambiae Kisumu strain in tunnel tests (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report genotyping of any insecticide-resistance markers (e.g., kdr, ace-1, etc.). It only mentions the use of pyrethroid-resistant strains in bioassays.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses mosquito strains (e.g., Cx. quinquefasciatus Muheza) originally collected in the field in Tanzania and Benin (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study evaluating indoxacarb-treated nets.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study mentions specific locations: Moshi and Muheza, Tanzania, and Cotonou, Benin (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted in 2015 (publication year) and describes recent experimental work.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary experimental study.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is reported in the paper or supplement.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of indoxacarb-treated mosquito nets against Anopheles gambiae and Culex quinquefasciatus using tunnel tests and ball-frame bioassays. It does not perform any genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report genotyping of any insecticide-resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype data is reported.
